title: Bus Routes
description: Find the minimum number of buses to travel from source to target using BFS on bus routes.
pseudocode:
1. map = Map<stop, List<busIndex>>
2. queue = [source], visitedBuses = Set()
3. count = 0
4. while queue not empty:
5.   count++
6.   for size of queue:
7.     curr = queue.pop()
8.     for bus in map[curr]:
9.       if bus not in visitedBuses:
10.        visitedBuses.add(bus)
11.        for stop in routes[bus]:
12.          if stop == target: return count
13.          queue.push(stop)

steps.note: Building graph: Mapping stops to bus indices.
Processing bus from stop 7, reaching target 6.
Target reached, returning total bus count.
